name: IDLES

whyMatters.en: Bristol post-punk/hardcore band whose Brutalism (2017) and Joy as an Act of Resistance (2018) put shouted political lyrics over dry, heavy rhythm sections.
whyMatters.zh: 布里斯托后朋克/硬核乐队；Brutalism（2017）与 Joy as an Act of Resistance（2018）把喊叫政治歌词叠在干、重的节奏组上。

essentialTracks.title: Never Fight a Man With a Perm

lyricQuotes: Danny Nedelko is a refugee / Danny Nedelko is a hard worker

shortBio.en: Bristol post-punk; Never Fight a Man With a Perm shows the chant-riff live mode.
shortBio.zh: 布里斯托后朋；Never Fight a Man With a Perm 展示口号—riff 现场模式。

body.en:
Formed 2009 in Bristol. Mid-2010s albums made them a festival staple: Joe Talbot’s bark, Bowen/Kiernan guitar scrapes, Devonshire’s locked bass, Beavis’s hardcore-adjacent drums.

Never Fight a Man With a Perm (2018) is a typical set piece—short riffs, gang vocals, on-stage physicality. They update 2010s post-punk without revival costume; lyrics name class, masculinity, and NHS-era Britain directly.
body.zh:
2009 年于布里斯托组建。2010 年代中期专辑使其成音乐节常备：Joe Talbot 吠叫、Bowen/Kiernan 吉他刮擦、Devonshire 锁死贝斯、Beavis 偏硬核鼓。

Never Fight a Man With a Perm（2018）是典型曲目——短 riff、群吼、舞台肢体。更新 2010 年代后朋而不穿复兴戏服；歌词直接点名阶级、男性气质与 NHS 时代英国。

body.en:
IDLES matter as post-punk that names Brexit-era Britain in plain speech—Talbot’s shouted lyrics over dry, heavy rhythm sections.

Brutalism (2017) and Joy as an Act of Resistance (2018) landed when UK guitar bands were returning to festivals with purpose.

No Joy Division cosplay: short songs, hardcore drum feel, gang vocals.

Never Fight a Man With a Perm is the live citation—chant-riff as crowd engine.
body.zh:
IDLES 要紧处是后朋用直白话语点名脱欧时代英国——Talbot 喊叫歌词叠干、重节奏组。

Brutalism（2017）与 Joy as an Act of Resistance（2018）落在英国吉他乐队带目的回归音乐节时。

无 Joy Division 扮装：短歌、硬核鼓感、群吼。

Never Fight a Man With a Perm 是现场引用——口号 riff 作人群引擎。

body.en:
2009 founding core Talbot, Bowen, Devonshire; Kiernan and Beavis join 2012—classic five unchanged through Ultra Mono (2020).

Dual guitar without a dedicated keyboard player; bass and drums carry the groove.

Bowen also produces—dry mixes, forward vocal, minimal reverb wash.

Live shows foreground Talbot’s physical presence and call-response with crowds.
body.zh:
2009 创始核心 Talbot、Bowen、Devonshire；Kiernan 与 Beavis 2012 年加入——经典五人经 Ultra Mono（2020）未变。

双吉他无专职键盘；贝斯与鼓扛 groove。

Bowen 兼制作——干混音、人声靠前、少混响糊。

现场突出 Talbot 肢体与观众 call-response。

body.en:
IDLES cite Joy Division and Talking Heads as method ancestors—bass-forward, dry vocal, economic song length—but reject 1970s costume.

2018–20 festival circuit adoption spread their chant-riff template to younger UK guitar bands.

Lyrics about class and toxic masculinity are the distinguishing document vs revival peers.

Citation peak is live energy plus two Partisan albums.
body.zh:
IDLES 引 Joy Division 与 Talking Heads 为方法祖先——贝斯前置、干人声、经济曲长——但拒绝 1970 年代戏服。

2018–20 音乐节线路采纳传播其口号 riff 模板至更年轻英国吉他乐队。

关于阶级与有毒男性气质的歌词是相对复兴同辈的区分文献。

引用峰值在现场能量加两张 Partisan 专辑。
